name: MOLUS G200
reset_steps: Press the DIM button on the light three times in a row.
The light's Bluetooth is now reset.
reset_source: Zhiyun support page 'ZHIYUN-MOLUS G200-Tutorials' (zhiyun-tech.com/en/service/support/816/1/show): 'triple-click the DIM button to reset the bluetooth'. The G200 user guide (B&H lit_files/1032691.pdf, device.report/manual/11251303) says 'Triple press: Reset Bluetooth'. Both read as search results on 18 Oct 2026; the pages themselves would not load.
note: Model code and name from didim99/HA-Zhiyun-Light (MIT). Only the white controls are driven; colour models still show white only.
